input.quote: (b) NON SOLICITATION. During the Term of this Agreement and during the three year period after the expiration or termination of this Agreement, the Licensee will not solicit any person employed by Licensor and/or its Affiliates to leave his or her employment with Licensor.
input.rationale: Article X(b) imposes a one-way non-solicit on us alone, for three years after expiration or termination, covering every person employed by Licensor and/or its Affiliates. That fails the fallback on two material terms and lands in walk-away territory: duration exceeds 24 months and scope covers all Vendor personnel rather than only those directly involved in performance. The clause does include an adequate carve-out (general job advertising, responses to advertisements and voluntary inquiries) and contains no no-hire, so the redline keeps that sentence and makes only the minimal edits needed to reach the fallback: mutual, limited to personnel directly involved in performance, 12 months from the end of that involvement. We note the injunctive-relief clause (p0126) still refers only to "Non Solicitation of Licensor Employees"; that one-sidedness is a minor drafting point flagged for information rather than a separate deviation.

proposal.summary: Make non-solicit mutual, limit to personnel directly involved in performance, and cut duration from 3 years to 12 months
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We narrowed this to our standard position: a mutual non-solicit limited to personnel directly involved in performance and running 12 months from the end of that involvement, rather than a one-way, three-year restriction covering every Licensor and Affiliate employee. The existing general-advertising and unsolicited-inquiry carve-out is retained.

ops.oldText: During the Term of this Agreement and during the three year period after the expiration or termination of this Agreement, the Licensee will not solicit any person employed by Licensor and/or its Affiliates to leave his or her employment with Licensor.
ops.newText: During the Term of this Agreement and during the twelve (12) month period after the last date on which the relevant individual was directly involved in the performance of this Agreement, neither party will solicit any person employed by the other party who was directly involved in the performance of this Agreement to leave his or her employment with that party.
